summary: Build practical skills for hybrid performance, psychological safety, and equitable development. Explore the five-day course and enquire with TrainingCred.
lede: Hybrid and remote team leadership training helps managers coordinate performance, communication and fair development across locations. For middle and senior managers, team leaders and people specialists, it builds practical skills in setting asynchronous communication agreements, structuring outcome-based check-ins, and reviewing equitable access to career opportunities using Microsoft Teams, Slack and Notion.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals responsible for the performance, cohesion, and fair development of hybrid or distributed teams.
audience: People managers using Microsoft Teams, Slack
modules: Hybrid Team Metrics and Leadership Reporting
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Experience supervising, supporting, or advising a team is recommended. Bring a current team-management challenge or a representative scenario; no coding is required. Advanced platform configuration and AI-assisted analysis are introduced at a conceptual level, while team agreements, check-in templates, and action plans receive practical workshop treatment.
